svg.text: Raspberry Pi 4B · 16×2 I²C LCD (PCF8574) · SG90 Servo Gate · 5× IR Proximity Sensors · USB Webcam
• Connect VCC to Pin 1 or Pin 17.
• Power all IR sensors from 3.3V ONLY.
5V on IR OUT → damages Pi GPIO!
• LCD and Servo use the 5V rail.
• IR debounce: 3 s stable before commit.
• Use USB webcam or IP cam (same Wi-Fi).
